child_list.content: My Summer Vacation Plan
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content: This summer, I have a great plan. First, I will go camping with my family. We will sleep in tents and cook food over a fire. I can’t wait to see the stars at night. Next, I plan to read ten books. I love reading about adventures and mysteries. It’s like traveling to new places without leaving home. I also want to learn to swim. My friend will teach me. Swimming is fun and a good way to stay cool. Lastly, I will help my mom in the garden. We will plant flowers and vegetables. I look forward to eating the vegetables we grow. This summer will be busy and fun.

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

child_list.content: 我的暑假计划
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 这个暑假，我有一个很棒的计划。首先，我将和家人去露营。我们将睡在帐篷里，用火烤食物。我迫不及待想看夜晚的星星。 接下来，我计划读十本书。我喜欢阅读关于冒险和神秘的故事。这就像不离开家就能去新的地方旅行一样。我还想学会游泳。我的朋友会教我。游泳很有趣，也是保持凉爽的好方法。最后，我会在花园里帮助妈妈。我们将种植花朵和蔬菜。我期待着吃我们种的蔬菜。这个暑假将会很忙碌也很有趣。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
